lines.text: [curious] So... where do backlinks actually come from?
Mostly from months of cold emails... and two hundred dollar invoices.
On Ryze, they come from the network itself. Three thousand websites, all trading links.
[warm] Say you make a sleep app. A meditation app mentions you... you mention a habit tracker. And every rating in the chain climbs.
And you? You'll receive up to fifty backlinks a month, on autopilot.
That's about ten thousand dollars in links, monthly.
